title: Spec: agent metadata data model and validation
description:
As a Kanbus maintainer, I want agent metadata validated at the data model boundary, so that invalid or dangerous payloads fail clearly before reaching git.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Agent metadata data model
  As a Kanbus user
  I want optional agent metadata validated on issues and comments
  So that provenance is structured and safe to store in git

  Scenario: Issue accepts valid agent metadata at create
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    When I create issue "kanbus-agent" with agent platform "cursor" model "composer-2.5"
    Then issue "kanbus-agent" should have agent platform "cursor" and model "composer-2.5"

  Scenario: Comment accepts valid agent metadata
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    And an issue "kanbus-aaa" exists
    When I add comment "Progress" on "kanbus-aaa" with agent platform "claude_code" model "claude-sonnet-4"
    Then the latest comment on "kanbus-aaa" should have agent platform "claude_code"

  Scenario: Agent metadata omitted when not provided
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    When I create issue "kanbus-plain" with title "Plain task" and type "task"
    Then issue "kanbus-plain" should not have agent metadata

  Scenario: Unknown platform string is rejected when invalid charset
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    When I attempt to create issue with agent platform "Cursor Pro!" and model "x"
    Then the operation should fail with "invalid agent platform"

  Scenario: Secret-like settings keys are rejected
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    When I attempt to add comment on "kanbus-aaa" with agent settings containing key "openai_api_key"
    Then the operation should fail with "agent settings must not contain secret-like keys"

  Scenario: Unknown settings keys are rejected
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    When I attempt to create issue with agent settings containing key "custom_prompt"
    Then the operation should fail with "unknown agent settings key"
```

## Implementation notes

- Add `AgentMetadata` to `python/src/kanbus/models.py` and `rust/src/models.rs`
- Add optional `agent: Option<AgentMetadata>` to `IssueData` and `IssueComment`
- Shared resolver in `agent_metadata.py` / `agent_metadata.rs`
- Issue `agent` writable only via create path; update path must not accept agent flags
